name: Fault
author: Angus McRitchie
description: Failed and restarting systemd units in the bar, across both the system and the user manager.

barWidget.description: Draws nothing while both systemd managers are healthy. When a unit fails or starts flapping, an icon appears with the units, what systemd reported, and the journal behind them.

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: Two short systemctl calls per manager per tick. A unit that flaps and recovers entirely between two ticks is missed.

schema.label: Journal lines per unit
schema.description: Read only while the panel is open.

schema.label: Watch the user manager
schema.description: Where timers, agents and anything you wrote yourself actually live. Most tools ignore it.
